(Larangan Penggunaan Jalan) (Jalan Persekutuan) (No. 9) 2021.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 19 Ogos 2021.

Larangan

yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (3) Jadual Pertama, dilarang.

ROAD TRANSPORT ACT 1987

ROAD TRANSPORT (PROHIBITION OF USE OF ROAD)

(FEDERAL ROADS) (NO. 9) ORDER 2021

WHEREAS by P.U. (B) 405/2021 published on 2 August 2021, notice was

given of the intention to make an order under section 70 of the

Road Transport Act 1987 [Act 333]:

AND WHEREAS no objection was received by the Senior Minister of Works

against the making of such order:

NOW THEREFORE, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 70 of the Act,

the Senior Minister of Works, after taking into consideration the matters referred to

in subsection 70(2) of the Act, makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Road Transport (Prohibition of Use of

Road) (Federal Roads) (No. 9) Order 2021.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 19 August 2021.

Prohibition

2. The driving of vehicles on the part of the road as specified in column (1) of

the First Schedule as shown on the map in the Second Schedule, otherwise than on

the routes specified in column (2) of the First Schedule, for the period specified

in column (3) of the First Schedule, is prohibited.
